high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a luxurious home with a modern design. The individual is wearing a stylish black leather trench coat over a matching dress, paired with black high-heeled shoes. They have short, straight hair and are holding a smartphone with a pink case. The setting is indoors, with large glass doors that open up to an outdoor area featuring a swimming pool and a view of lush greenery and hills in the background. The interior has a sleek, contemporary aesthetic with dark flooring and gold accents on the walls and ceiling.
